description: This file defines classes related to WFA map TLV for associated STA MLD configuration report, including class structures, methods, and data members for handling associated STA MLD configuration data.

classes.name: tlvAssociatedStaMldConfigurationReport
classes.description: Represents the TLV for associated STA MLD configuration report, providing methods to access and modify report data.

classes.name: cAffiliatedSta
classes.description: Represents an affiliated station within the MLD configuration report, providing access to BSSID, MAC address, and reserved fields.

methods.name: tlvAssociatedStaMldConfigurationReport
methods.description: Constructor initializing the report from buffer or base class.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the TLV.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the TLV.

methods.name: sta_mld_mac_addr
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the STA MLD.

methods.name: ap_mld_mac_addr
methods.description: Returns the MAC address of the AP MLD.

methods.name: num_affiliated_sta
methods.description: Returns the number of affiliated stations.

methods.name: affiliated_sta
methods.description: Returns a tuple indicating success and reference to affiliated station at index.

methods.name: create_affiliated_sta
methods.description: Creates a new affiliated station object.

methods.name: add_affiliated_sta
methods.description: Adds an affiliated station to the report.

methods.name: class_swap
methods.description: Performs byte order swapping for class members.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the object, preparing it for use.

methods.name: get_initial_size
methods.description: Returns the initial size of the object.
